question: A form should hide the 'Escalation reason' field unless the Priority field is set to Critical — both the moment the form is first opened (if Priority is already Critical) and immediately afterward if the user changes Priority to Critical mid-edit. Which combination of Client Scripts achieves this?

choices.text: A single onLoad script is enough, since it re-evaluates automatically whenever any field changes
An onLoad script (to handle the form's initial state) together with an onChange script on Priority (to react to later edits)
A single onChange script on Priority is enough, since it also fires once when the form first loads
An onSubmit script, since visibility only needs to be correct at the moment of submission

explanation: onLoad only fires once, when the form finishes loading — it won't react to later field edits. onChange on Priority only fires on subsequent changes — it doesn't run for the form's initial state. Covering both moments requires both script types working together.
pieges: Assuming onLoad re-runs automatically whenever any field changes — it doesn't, it only fires once per form load.
Assuming onChange also covers the form's initial state — it only fires in response to a user-driven change.
